gate.why: compared against the branch-coverage baseline, which is MEASURED to run at one transaction; running deeper than the thing being compared to is not a comparison

artefact.why: no second party to match, so the question is what this method can REACH. tx>=2 is the only configuration measured to reach cross-function state at all

gate.why: setMinLockPeriodRatio is an owner-gated scalar setter; the St1inch constructor initializes ERC20 metadata and voting-power tables that are not part of this unit's path predicate and made prior no-fixture path coverage spend most of its budget in solver unknowns. The fixture replaces deployment with the minimal entry state needed for the gate: a nonzero Ownable._owner. The unit still distinguishes owner and non-owner paths through msg.sender.

foundry.why: Foundry cannot install St1inch runtimeCode directly because the contract has immutables. For replay only, deploy with a constructor value in the Solidity-checked valid expBase interval, then overwrite the ESBMC fixture scalar state.
